Welcome to Urban SKN

Urban SKN is a modern wellness boutique where luxury meets intentional self-care.

Created for the woman who does it all, our space was designed as an escape—a place where results-driven skincare and therapeutic bodywork come together to restore not only your skin, but your mind and body as well.

Every experience is thoughtfully curated with the belief that wellness is not a luxury reserved for special occasions; it’s an essential part of living well. From the moment you walk through our doors, the pace slows, the distractions fade, and your time becomes entirely yours.

Our signature facial experiences combine advanced skincare with restorative rituals, customized to your unique skin concerns while incorporating elements like massage, lymphatic techniques, aromatherapy, and relaxation to leave you glowing from the inside out. Our massage therapies are designed to release tension, regulate the nervous system, and create lasting wellness, whether you’re seeking deep relaxation, recovery, or specialized prenatal care.

At Urban SKN, we believe beautiful skin begins with a healthy foundation and that true self-care extends far beyond a treatment room. That’s why we’ve created a boutique experience that embraces skincare, wellness, education, and community—all under one roof.

Founded by licensed Esthetician and Massage Therapist Chelsea, Urban SKN was born from a vision of creating a space that feels elevated yet approachable, luxurious yet deeply personal. Every detail, from the treatment protocols to the products on our shelves, has been intentionally selected to deliver exceptional results while making every guest feel genuinely cared for.

Whether you’re joining us for your monthly facial, an afternoon massage, or simply taking an hour to reset, Urban SKN is your invitation to slow down, breathe deeper, and invest in yourself.

Because wellness isn’t an indulgence—it’s a lifestyle.

Urban SKN
Where modern skincare meets intentional wellness.
